schema.description: Request body for a Qwen multimodal image generation or edit. The `example` below is the COMFY ROUTER form and deliberately omits `model`, which Router fills from the `{model}` path segment; a direct v1 call to POST /proxy/qwen/api/v1/services/aigc/multimodal-generation/generation must add `model` to it. One example cannot serve both surfaces - this component is the Router input schema for BOTH qwen spellings, so an example naming either one is refused by the other model's route for naming a different model, while the omitting form is valid on both.

content.text: A single red maple leaf on a plain white background.

input.description: The input parameter object containing the request messages

messages.description: The request content array. Only single-round conversations are supported, so the array must contain exactly one object

content.description: The message content array. Text-to-image contains one text object; image editing contains 1-3 image objects and one text object

image.description: The URL or Base64 encoded data of an input image. 1-3 images are supported for image editing

text.description: The positive prompt that describes the image content, style, and composition to generate or edit

role.description: The role of the message sender. Must be set to user

model.description: The ID of the model to call for multimodal image generation and editing. Available values are qwen-image-3.0-pro and qwen-image-3.0. It is NOT in this schema's `required` list because Comfy Router fills it from the `{model}` path segment of /v2/models/qwen/{model}, so a Router caller omits it; a direct v1 call to the /proxy/ route must supply it.

parameters.description: Additional parameters to control image generation

n.description: The number of output images. Range 1-6, default is 1

negative_prompt.description: The negative prompt that describes content you do not want to appear in the image

prompt_extend.description: Whether to enable intelligent prompt rewriting. Default is true

prompt_extend_mode.description: The prompt rewriting method, direct (default, supported for T2I and I2I) or agent (T2I only)

seed.description: Random number seed to control randomness. Range [0, 2147483647]

size.description: The output image resolution in the format width*height, for example 1024*1024. The API accepts a pixel area between 262144 (512*512) and 6553600 (2560*2560) with an aspect ratio between 1:8 and 8:1. If not specified, the model automatically recommends a resolution based on the prompt

watermark.description: Whether to add a watermark. Default is false
